en: Is this meeting ever going to end?
This presentation looks like it's from the 90s.
Does the boss even know what they're talking about...
So sleepy, need bubble tea.
Finally, it's over!
No more meetings, I'm losing my mind.
My bladder is about to explode...
Finally can go back to slacking off.
What kind of nonsense is this now?
Empty promises, definitely empty promises.
As long as the pay is right, whatever.
My liver is aching in anticipation...
Wow, an elite just dropped in!
A try-hard is here, run!
Hope they can carry the project.
Looks tough, hope they aren't a fraud.

zh: 太好了，试用期只有五个月零三十天
en: Great! The probation period is only five months and thirty days.

zh: 听说项目负责人是老板的熟人
en: I heard the project lead is a close acquaintance of the boss.

zh: 据说负责人很喜欢发消息抽打同事
en: Word has it that the lead loves spamming messages to whip colleagues into shape.

zh: 干一个月没被优化就是胜利
en: Lasting a month without getting "optimized" is already a victory.

zh: 嘿嘿 我的挂机摸鱼游戏已经准备好了
en: Heheh, my idle/slacker game is already up and running.

zh: 掏香蕉的钱就只能请到猴子……
en: If you pay peanuts, you get monkeys.

zh: 工资只够我打卡，干活是另外的价钱
en: My salary only covers my attendance; anything beyond that costs extra.
Say goodbye to clocking out tonight.
Oh no, did THAT one assign work again?
The seat's still warm from the last poor soul…

zh: 我祖传的摸鱼绝活，启动！
en: Time to activate my ancestral slacking techniques!

zh: 领导说干完这个项目就给我们放假了
en: The boss says we will be promoted after this project.

zh: 今天的咖啡涨价了，喝不起了。
en: I can't afford the coffee anymore.
I was only halfway through my bathroom break…

zh: 水都还没接呢就被拽回来了。
en: Hauled back before I even refilled my water.

zh: 我就起来活动下颈椎而已！
en: I was just stretching my neck, I swear!
Isn't it almost time to clock out?!
Haha! Guess I'm just sleeping here tonight.
Off to enjoy the good life~

zh: 准备去一个更好的地方。
en: Off to a better place.
Severance is only N+0.1?

zh: 我要向所有人避雷这家公司！
en: I'm warning everyone to steer clear of this company!
Scab coworkers, goodbye forever!!
Heading home to cram for the civil service exam.
I'm not even 35 yet!

zh: 或许这就是牛马的宿命……
en: Maybe this is just a workhorse's fate…

zh: 哈哈，我就知道迟早有这天。
en: Ha, I knew this day would come sooner or later.
Hold on, let me finish my meal allowance first.

zh: 一天天的又在这大搞形式主义
en: Another day of corporate box-ticking theater.

zh: 培训完我的绩效还有救吗
en: After this "training", is my KPI even salvageable?

zh: 还不如讲讲被开了怎么仲裁
en: Might as well teach us how to file for arbitration after a layoff.

zh: 培训我有什么用，快进到蒸馏算了
en: Training me is pointless — just fast-forward to optimizing me out.
